title: Inner Child Round 9 Spots
intro: Round 9 read your guide Human Written in both halves. These are the 26 windows where it was less sure, on 21 cards. The three paragraphs of Hearthwork: Taking Turns come first: eight of the windows are there, both Low ones and the one AI window among them. I checked that section alone this turn, with your driving-instructor aside back, and then each of its paragraphs. Alone, its first and last paragraphs read AI, so those two are the ones I'd work on.

Every card is a stretch for you: Keep it as it is, or Edit it, which opens the paragraph for your own version. No card puts words of mine into your text. The other 18 cards are windows that read Human at Medium; I'd leave them, the short ones especially. Your answers save as you click. When you're done, tell me in the chat, and I'll put your versions in and check them.

caveat.label: Read AI or Low
caveat.about: Where Pangram read AI, or Human at Low confidence: the windows a next Pangram version is likeliest to call AI. All of them are in Hearthwork: Taking Turns.

reread.label: Read Human at Medium
reread.about: Human, but not at High confidence. For you to look at; I'd leave most of them.

suggestions.title: Hearthwork's premise, as a list
suggestions.why: In the whole guide, this paragraph holds round 9's Low window, "You speak. I listen. Then we switch.", with Medium windows on either side of it. Alone, it reads AI (81%). Its list is Hearthwork's premise word for word as your Hearthwork article gives it.
suggestions.reading: Round 9, half B, in the whole guide ([result](https://www.pangram.com/feed/f3b33647-484f-4203-9709-db0b04ab8f2d)): "Attention without interpretation, advice, or fixing." Human (Medium); "You speak. I listen. Then we switch." Human (Low); "Presence, Warmth, Discipline, Confidentiality." Human (Medium). This paragraph alone ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/8668b6dc-7991-41fc-ba98-e361470ba1f5)): AI Detected, 81% AI: its first sentence Human (Low), then the rest of the list and the sentence after it AI (Low). The section alone ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/f2d397ae-6c78-4c5c-a855-341ce23285ef)): AI in every window.
suggestions.advice_note: This is one of the two to work on. What reads as a model's: the run of fragments, the three-beat "You speak. I listen. Then we switch.", and "interpretation, advice, or fixing", a list of three with no catch-all, which your rule says to avoid. Here the premise describes Hearthwork for someone who hasn't met it, so I'd say it in a sentence or two of yours and keep the list as it is for the Hearthwork article. The sentence after it ("because modern life rarely gives you anything like it") may read better with something concrete in place of "modern life".

This paragraph alone ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/197fd1b3-519e-47b9-b6ed-54457f4e5a86)): Human Written, 0% AI; "Keeping what you say private, ..." Human (Low), three windows Medium, two High.
suggestions.advice_note: The lowest priority of the three, since it reads Human alone. If anything, Pangram is least sure of the job-by-job pairing ("lend you the Nurturer", "lends you the Protector"). I'd leave it.

suggestions.title: Borrowed adulthood, and whether it's therapy
suggestions.why: Your driving-instructor aside is back, as you said. Even so, this paragraph alone reads AI in every window (100%), the aside's sentence at High. In the whole guide, round 9 read its first two sentences AI (Low) without the aside, and round 8 read them Human with it.
suggestions.reading: Round 9, half B, without the aside ([result](https://www.pangram.com/feed/f3b33647-484f-4203-9709-db0b04ab8f2d)): the first two sentences AI (Low, 35 words); "Is that therapy?" Human (Low); "Well, not the mainstream kind, but yes, for sure." Human (Medium). Round 8, half B, with the aside ([result](https://www.pangram.com/feed/bd483bd6-edab-4f39-834c-3d959b0abb72)): "The peer doesn't become your permanent parent, though." Human (Medium), the aside's sentence Human (High). This paragraph alone, with the aside ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/1468591d-d54f-4d7a-9d8e-5b2a87027305)): AI Generated, 100% AI. The section alone ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/f2d397ae-6c78-4c5c-a855-341ce23285ef)): AI in every window.
suggestions.advice_note: The other one to work on, and the more important. Three things read as a model's: the list of three with no catch-all ("show you a capacity, help you get the hang of it, and give it back to you"), which your rule says to avoid; the question and answer ("Is that therapy? Well, not the mainstream kind, but yes, for sure."); and the both-sides closer ("Professional therapy's still useful for what it does, and peers and community do something else, so a serious healing path can include both."). Your aside stays either way.
